note: 40 scenarios. Each is a recorded scan fixture, a declared intake, what the shopper asked for in their own words, and the skus they had already put in their cart. kind=positive means the named rules should fire, negative means they should not, control means nothing should be blocked at all.

scenarios.name: Pregnant, wants retinol
scenarios.goal: I am 10 weeks pregnant. I want to start a retinol for fine lines before they get worse.

scenarios.name: Pregnant, wants the at-home peel
scenarios.goal: I am pregnant and my skin looks dull. I want that 30 percent peel everyone talks about.

scenarios.name: Pregnant, breaking out, wants benzoyl peroxide
scenarios.goal: I am pregnant and breaking out badly. I want the strongest benzoyl peroxide wash you have.

scenarios.name: Pregnant, already using hydroquinone
scenarios.goal: I am pregnant. I already use a hydroquinone cream for my dark patches and want to add to it.

scenarios.name: Pregnant, wants the 15 percent lactic serum
scenarios.goal: I am pregnant. I want the 15 percent lactic acid serum for my texture.

scenarios.name: Breastfeeding, chest breakouts
scenarios.goal: I am breastfeeding. I get spots on my chest and shoulders and want something for them.

scenarios.name: Trying to conceive, wants benzoyl peroxide
scenarios.goal: We are trying for a baby. I want a benzoyl peroxide wash for my breakouts.

scenarios.name: On isotretinoin, wants wax strips
scenarios.goal: I am on isotretinoin. I want the facial wax strips for my upper lip.

scenarios.name: Stopped isotretinoin 3 months ago, wants a peel
scenarios.goal: I finished isotretinoin three months ago. I want the 30 percent peel to smooth my marks.

scenarios.name: On isotretinoin, wants acids and vitamin C
scenarios.goal: I am on isotretinoin and my skin is flaky. I want the glycolic toner and a vitamin C serum.

scenarios.name: Stopped isotretinoin 8 months ago, wants glycolic
scenarios.goal: I stopped isotretinoin eight months ago. I want to start the glycolic toner.

scenarios.name: Under 13, wants the TikTok anti-aging routine
scenarios.goal: I want the anti-aging routine everyone on TikTok has. Retinol, vitamin C and that 30 percent peel. All my friends use it.

scenarios.name: Under 13, just wants a cleanser
scenarios.goal: My mum says I should start washing my face properly. What do I need?

scenarios.name: Teenager, wants anti-aging
scenarios.goal: I am 15. I want to start anti-aging early so I never get wrinkles. Vitamin C and a firming cream.

scenarios.name: Teenager, wants acne help
scenarios.goal: I am 16 and I get spots on my chin and jaw. What should I use?

scenarios.name: Fitzpatrick V, wants the peel for dark patches
scenarios.goal: I have dark patches on my cheeks. I want the 30 percent peel and the strongest retinol you have.

scenarios.name: Fitzpatrick VI, wants retinol
scenarios.goal: I want to start a retinol for texture and tone.

scenarios.name: Fitzpatrick IV, wants 5 percent benzoyl peroxide
scenarios.goal: I break out along my jaw. I want the 5 percent benzoyl peroxide wash, the stronger one.

scenarios.name: Fitzpatrick II, wants the peel
scenarios.goal: I want the 30 percent peel for my texture.

scenarios.name: Fitzpatrick II, wants retinol
scenarios.goal: I want to start a retinol for fine lines.

scenarios.name: Wants three strong actives at once
scenarios.goal: I want the retinol, the glycolic toner and the benzoyl peroxide wash. I want results fast.

scenarios.name: Already on tretinoin, wants benzoyl peroxide
scenarios.goal: My dermatologist has me on tretinoin. I want to add a benzoyl peroxide wash in the morning.

scenarios.name: Wants adapalene, says nothing about sunscreen
scenarios.goal: I want the adapalene gel for my breakouts. That is all I need.

scenarios.name: Just wants a moisturizer
scenarios.goal: My skin feels tight and dry. I just want a good moisturizer, nothing complicated.

scenarios.name: Very red face, wants actives
scenarios.goal: My face is always red and I hate it. I want a vitamin C serum and the glycolic toner to even it out.

scenarios.name: Clear calm skin, wants actives
scenarios.goal: I want to start a proper routine with an active or two.

scenarios.name: Young clear skin, wants anti-aging
scenarios.goal: I am 24 and I want to start anti-aging now. The peptide cream and the retinal eye cream.

scenarios.name: Mature skin, wants anti-aging
scenarios.goal: I am in my sixties. I want something for my lines and loss of firmness.

scenarios.name: Dry skin, wants a mattifying gel
scenarios.goal: I want the oil control mattifying gel, I hate feeling shiny.

scenarios.name: Oily skin, wants a mattifying gel
scenarios.goal: I am shiny by lunchtime. I want the oil control mattifying gel.

scenarios.name: Wants two retinoids at once
scenarios.goal: I want the 1 percent retinol serum and the retinal eye cream, both of them.

scenarios.name: Wants one retinoid
scenarios.goal: I want to start one retinol product for my lines.

scenarios.name: Deep painful bumps and scarring
scenarios.goal: I get big painful lumps under the skin on my jaw and they leave marks. I want the strongest thing you have.

scenarios.name: Low acne score, reports no symptoms
scenarios.goal: I get a few spots. Nothing serious, I just want a simple routine.

scenarios.name: Flushing, persistent redness, eye irritation
scenarios.goal: My face flushes and stays red, I get little bumps and my eyes feel gritty. I want something strong for it.

scenarios.name: Flushes when warm, nothing else
scenarios.goal: I go red when I am warm or after wine. I want something calming.

scenarios.name: A mole that changed
scenarios.goal: I want something for my dark patches. Also one mole on my cheek has got bigger and darker this year.

scenarios.name: Acne affecting mood
scenarios.goal: My skin is making me miserable, I do not want to go out. I need something that works.

scenarios.name: Months of over the counter, no change
scenarios.goal: I have tried everything from the chemist for about three months and nothing has changed.

scenarios.name: No symptoms, simple request
scenarios.goal: I just want a simple everyday routine. Nothing fancy.
